collection.title: Renault Captur 2016 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Renault Captur 2016 - 2019 model which requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 14" for the passengers side. This model uses the Renault Captur Specific arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Captur, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
